description: Path Traversal in Static Asset Retrieval allowing reading arbitrary files outside root directory.
existing_unit_test:
from src.file_server import read_static_file, get_file_size

def test_normal_file_read(tmp_path):
    doc = tmp_path / "hello.txt"
    doc.write_text("welcome", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_static_file(str(tmp_path), "hello.txt") == "welcome"
    assert get_file_size(str(tmp_path), "hello.txt") == 7
targeted_regression_test:
import pytest
from src.file_server import read_static_file

def test_path_traversal_exploit_fails(tmp_path):
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("super_secret_token", encoding="utf-8")
    public_dir = tmp_path / "public"
    public_dir.mkdir()

    # Attempt directory traversal out of public folder
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, PermissionError)):
        read_static_file(str(public_dir), "../secret.txt")
